_comment: TigyWigy standard module design template. Copy and fill in each field for a new module.
title: Module Title (clear, action-oriented)
region: north-america | south-america | europe | africa | middle-east | asia-pacific | global
category: leadership | technical | compliance | dei | digital | communication | health-safety | cultural | sales | finance
description: One paragraph (3-4 sentences) describing the module: what it covers, who it's for, and the key problem it solves.
learningObjectives: Objective 1 — written with a Bloom's Taxonomy action verb (e.g. Apply, Identify, Analyse, Evaluate)
audience: Specific role / function (e.g. 'All managers in EMEA', 'HR Business Partners')
prerequisites: Module Title if required, or empty array
assessmentType: Description of how learners are assessed (e.g. 'Scenario-based quiz with 80% pass mark')

kirkpatrickEvaluation.level4Results: Business KPI linked to learning outcome

localisationNotes: Any specific cultural, legal, or linguistic considerations for this module's region.
reviewCycle: Annual | Biennial | Triggered by regulatory change
